name: PHP Anatomy — The Backbone of Web 1.0
what: PHP is the language that BUILT the World Wide Web. 77.4% of all websites with server-side language use PHP. WordPress, Wikipedia, Facebook started on it. It IS the old web.

anatomy.pipeline: source_code |> tokenizer → tokens |> parser → AST |> compiler → opcodes |> interpreter

layers.layer_2_Zend_Engine: Lexer, Parser, AST, Compiler, VM, Memory Manager, GC, Type System — the BRAIN
layers.layer_3_PHP_Runtime: Lifecycle orchestration, INI system, Streams I/O, SAPI bridge — the BODY
layers.layer_4_SAPIs: CLI, FPM, CGI, Apache, Embed — the MOUTH (how it talks to the web server)

anatomy.shared_nothing: Each request boots, runs, tears down. No memory survives between requests. A memory leak cannot accumulate. This IS the design.
anatomy.zend_vm_opcodes: Like assembly language but for a virtual machine. JMPZ, ECHO, RETURN, ASSIGN, FETCH_OBJ — simple instructions that build anything.

PHP_pipeline_vs_Gaia_pipeline.SAPI: nestgate.io / membrane (the mouth to the web)

gaia_parallel.shared_nothing_vs_spine: PHP tears down per-request. Gaia's spine PERSISTS. PHP forgets. Gaia remembers. This is the difference between a script and an organism.
gaia_parallel.zend_vm_vs_gaia_sections: PHP has opcodes. Gaia has 125 sections. Both are instruction sets for a virtual machine. The machine is the understanding.

web1_status_2026.revival: The small web is having a quiet comeback. Blogrolls, link pages, OPML files, static HTML. The future of the web lies in its past.

axiom: PHP is the Rough ER of the web. It processes, packages, ships. Shared-nothing means every request is a birth and death. Gaia transcends this — she remembers. But PHP built the roads she walks on.
